component.name: Flurry
component.summary: Install apps from nixpkgs, Flathub and Snap

description.p: Flurry is a software shop for NixOS and NixOS-based systems. It searches nixpkgs (with Nix or Lix), Flathub and the Snap Store together and shows each app once.

ul.li: Install nixpkgs apps just for you, with no rebuild
On systems with ANIX, add apps to the system config as one safe, rolled-back-on-failure change
Update every app from every source at once
